scope: development evidence of the motor assist v1 (session scratchpad m4b/assist): not gate results, not flight evidence

accel_attempt1.note:
Height lost while accelerating from low speed vs the requested acceleration (development measurement).

Starts: (a) the logged state of minus-brain09b-r4-01 at 22.95 s (the turn-first release; brain warmed on the recorded
inputs), (b) a hover at rest at 1.5 m. The horizontal request (fixed direction: toward the next ring, i.e. the logged
request direction at 23.6 s for (a), +x for (b)) grows from the start speed to 5 m/s with:
  pilot      the pilot's own slew (command_acceleration 10 m/s^2 with the 0.25 s taper)
  slew_A     at most A m/s^2 (then the pilot's taper)
  lead_L     the pilot's slew, but never more than L m/s above the measured horizontal speed (closed loop)
and a vertical request of B m/s (bias; 0 = level). 3 s horizon. Measures: height loss (start - min z), lowest vz,
speed at 1 s / 2 s / 3 s, time to 4 m/s, stick chatter.
usage: accel.py OUT.json [controller ...]
